{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders (after removing QA): {len(loyal_completed_clean)}")
print(f"Mean revenue (USD, excluding QA): {mean_revenue_clean:.2f}")"}
